0022600146.text: The 3-0 Trail Blazers, who have won three straight, host the 4-0 Memphis Grizzlies, who are on a four-game winning streak. Portland sits 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 3rd in the West, while Memphis is 2nd in the Southwest and 4th in the West. Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Chris Youngblood (ankle, soreness) are both out for Portland, and the teams have not met yet this season, following Portland's 3-1 win in the 2025-26 season series, including a 122-114 victory in Memphis on March 4.
